candidates.name: Astera Labs
candidates.thesis: Rack-scale AI connectivity is broadening from retimers into fabric switching, optics and custom connectivity; Q2 revenue rose 104% YoY and Scorpio is ramping ahead of prior expectations.
candidates.risk: Premium valuation, hyperscaler/customer concentration and execution risk as new product families ramp.

candidates.name: Credo Technology
candidates.thesis: Energy-efficient high-speed AI interconnect remains a structural bottleneck; FY2026 revenue more than tripled and OmniConnect expands the addressable market into scale-in memory connectivity.
candidates.risk: High valuation and customer concentration; Q1 FY2027 results are not due until September 1.

candidates.name: Celestica
candidates.thesis: AI data-center hardware platforms are driving exceptional growth and margin expansion; the raised outlook and $3B equity raise explicitly aimed at accelerating global AI infrastructure growth strengthen capacity optionality.
candidates.risk: Equity dilution, lower structural margins than semiconductor IP businesses and execution/capital-allocation risk on rapid expansion.

candidates.name: Lumentum Holdings
candidates.thesis: Optical connectivity is penetrating deeper into AI racks; FY2026 revenue rose 83% and Q1 FY2027 guidance implies another large sequential step-up with 1.6T, OCS and CPO-related products layering in.
candidates.risk: Very strong price momentum raises valuation/drawdown risk; optical cycles can be volatile and Q4 GAAP results include a large one-time debt extinguishment loss.

candidates.name: Fabrinet
candidates.thesis: Advanced optical manufacturing is benefiting directly from AI data-center optical demand; Q4 revenue grew 45% YoY, EPS faster than revenue, and Q1 FY2027 guidance points to continued sequential growth.
candidates.risk: Customer concentration and outsourced-manufacturing economics; sharp post-earnings volatility shows high expectations are embedded.

candidates.name: Arista Networks
candidates.thesis: High-quality AI networking leader with 37.7% Q2 revenue growth, nearly 50% non-GAAP operating margin and 1.6T AI fabric platforms extending its switching moat.
candidates.risk: Large-cap maturity and premium valuation reduce multibagger asymmetry versus earlier-stage candidates; hyperscaler spending concentration remains relevant.

candidates.name: Coherent Corp.
candidates.thesis: Broad photonics portfolio and manufacturing scale are benefiting from the copper-to-optics transition in AI data centers; Q4 revenue grew 34% YoY with meaningful margin expansion and management sees accelerating customer demand.
candidates.risk: Broader portfolio dilutes pure-play AI exposure; capacity expansion and optical pricing cycles can pressure returns if demand normalizes.

candidates.name: Nebius Group
candidates.thesis: AI cloud demand and contracted capacity visibility remain exceptional, but the model is becoming much more capital intensive as Nebius races to build capacity.
candidates.risk: Q2 net loss, $5.7B capex and a newly upsized $5B convertible financing increase leverage, dilution and execution risk materially.

candidates.name: Ciena
candidates.thesis: Optical networking remains a structural AI infrastructure beneficiary, with strong growth acceleration and exposure to next-generation high-speed data-center connectivity.
candidates.risk: Customer concentration, telecom cyclicality and valuation sensitivity after strong rerating.

candidates.name: Vertiv Holdings
candidates.thesis: Power and liquid-cooling infrastructure remain critical bottlenecks as AI rack density rises, supporting durable organic growth and operating leverage.
candidates.risk: Premium valuation and sensitivity to hyperscaler capex expectations; industrial capacity expansion can create cyclicality.

candidates.name: Amphenol
candidates.thesis: High-speed interconnect and communications exposure is compounding with broad diversification; Q2 sales rose 55% reported and 30% organically, orders reached $10.7B and book-to-bill was 1.23.
candidates.risk: Acquisition-driven reported growth and large-cap scale make it less asymmetric than smaller emerging compounders; valuation is demanding.

candidates.name: GE Vernova
candidates.thesis: AI/data-center electricity demand reinforces a multi-year power and grid bottleneck; Q2 orders grew 88% organically, backlog expanded sharply and guidance was raised.
candidates.risk: Very strong rerating, long-cycle execution and project timing; not a pure-play AI growth company.
